okay.en: Stop pretending that everything's okay. It's not.
okay.zh: 不要再假装一切都好了，不是这样的！

opinion.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
opinion.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

owe.en: I owe it you that I am still alive.

offer.en: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
offer.zh: 如果您同意, 我想给他这份工作。

official.zh: 汤姆不是选出来的官员。

obey.en: They don't always obey their parents.
obey.zh: 他们并不总是服从他们的父母。

oxygen.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
oxygen.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

occur.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
occur.zh: 下雨天容易发生交通事故。

obvious.en: It's obvious why his stomach hurts.
obvious.zh: 他为什么会胃痛的原因很明显。

overestimate.en: We cannot overestimate the value of health.
overestimate.zh: 我们不能高估健康的价值。

organ.en: Do you know how to play the organ?

ought.en: Don't you think you ought to write them a thank-you note?
ought.zh: 你不觉得你应该给他们写一封感谢信吗？

occasionally.en: The mother occasionally reread her son's letter.
occasionally.zh: 这位母亲偶尔会重温她的儿子的信件。

oil.en: Japan depends on foreign countries for oil.

original.en: Tom makes his own original Christmas cards every year.
original.zh: 汤姆每年都会制作自己独创的圣诞节贺卡。

orphan.en: He became an orphan when he was ten.

onto.en: If we'd arrived ten minutes earlier, we would've made it onto the plane.
onto.zh: 要是我们早十分钟到的话，我们就能赶上飞机了。

overcoat.en: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
overcoat.zh: 尽管天气很冷，孩子却没有大衣穿。

oven.en: The cake should just about be ready to be taken out of the oven.
oven.zh: 蛋糕应该差不多可以出炉了。

ordinary.en: I did nothing out of the ordinary.

optimistic.en: I'm not as optimistic as you are.

overseas.en: I'd like to make an overseas call.

offend.en: I didn't mean to offend anyone.

odd.en: One is the smallest odd number.

overtime.en: I had to work overtime yesterday.

owner.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
owner.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

obviously.en: He can speak French, and obviously English.
obviously.zh: 他能说法语，当然还有英语。

obligation.en: It is our obligation to help.

object.en: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.
object.zh: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。

outdoors.en: The party will be held outdoors, weather permitting.
outdoors.zh: 若天气许可的话，派对将会在户外举行。

objection.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
objection.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

overwhelm.en: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
overwhelm.zh: 我没有想要让你不知所措。

orbit.en: It takes 165 years for Neptune to orbit around the sun.
orbit.zh: 海王星绕行太阳一周要花一百六十五年。

ocean.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
ocean.zh: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

otherwise.en: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.
otherwise.zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭就要迟到了。

opposite.en: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.
opposite.zh: 平行四边形的对边平行。

opening.en: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.

operation.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
operation.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

orchard.en: They stole apples from my orchard.
orchard.zh: 他们从我的果园偷了苹果。

organize.en: I keep meaning to organize my desk.

overhead.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
overhead.zh: 我看见一架直升飞机在头顶飞。

opportunity.en: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
opportunity.zh: 你所要做的便是好好把握这千载难逢的机会。

overcome.en: How to overcome the high value of the yen is a big problem.
overcome.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

operate.en: The doctor decided to operate at once.

organic.en: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
organic.zh: 汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。

obstinate.en: He became more obstinate as he grew older.
obstinate.zh: 他年纪越大变得越顽固。

obscure.en: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.

officer.en: The police officer arrested the burglar.

overlook.en: These kinds of mistakes are easy to overlook.
overlook.zh: 这种错误很容易被人忽视。

offensive.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.
offensive.zh: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。

organization.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.
organization.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。

oath.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

occasional.en: Tomorrow's weather should be sunny with occasional rain.

orchestra.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
orchestra.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

oneself.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
oneself.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

outline.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
outline.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

oak.en: When it's windy, the leaves of the old oak rustle and its branches creak.
oak.zh: 刮风的时候，老橡树的叶子会沙沙作响，树枝会发出嘎吱声。

operator.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
operator.zh: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

owing.en: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
owing.zh: 南极因为有大陆，所以气温低于北极。
